purpose: Fresh-main Wave-2 extension layered on the landed 25/14/12 canonical checkpoint. It promotes two already-audited material-characterisation families and carries four non-counting/access-blocked records without changing the injection-process waveform metric.

inventoryEntries.title: Injection-moulded Nylon-12 XRD material-characterisation dataset
inventoryEntries.recordUnit: XRD detector intensity value from series explicitly labelled Injection Molded Nylon 12
inventoryEntries.sampling: material-characterisation trace; category-axis coordinates excluded; not an injection-machine/cavity waveform
inventoryEntries.statusNote: Exact CC BY 4.0 DOCX/PPTX publisher package is SHA-verified. Only the XRD series explicitly labelled Injection Molded Nylon 12 is accepted: 6,588 direct intensity values. Powder/SLS series, XRD axis values, SLS stress-strain curves, UTS box-plot summaries and route-ambiguous MDSC rows remain excluded.

inventoryEntries.title: XPS material/tool-interface characterisation dataset
inventoryEntries.sampling: 88 VAMAS XPS blocks; detector-dependent Counts arrays only; not an injection-machine/cavity waveform
inventoryEntries.statusNote: Exact CC BY 4.0 VAMAS source is SHA-verified and standards-parser profiled. 71,868 detector Counts values are accepted; energy coordinates, Transmission/calibration variables and the separate OPJU visualisation project are excluded.

inventoryEntries.title: Injection-moulding process/manufacturing documentation supplement
inventoryEntries.sampling: two-page process/manufacturing supplement; no delivered specimen-level result arrays or machine time series
inventoryEntries.statusNote: Exact publisher supplement is fingerprinted and useful as injection-moulding process documentation, but it contains no source-profiled measured result arrays. It remains non-counting and noncommercial education/research scoped.

inventoryEntries.title: DIC chart workbook with missing external measurement workbook

inventoryEntries.title: Wear/TGA/FTIR/SEM publisher dataset record
